name: Holy Ground
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square fantasy MMO ability icon, legible at 24 pixels and in grayscale. Create an original 2D painted icon for Holy Ground, a paladin ability that consecrates an area beneath the caster and repeatedly damages enemies standing there. Show a close, slightly overhead view of dark stone ground split by one wide radiant golden circular field, with a simple central sunburst glowing upward from the stone. Convey an area on the ground, not a floating shield or a weapon. Strong contrast, bold simple shapes, navy charcoal shadows and warm gold holy light, textured hand-painted fantasy art. Reference image is for painterly style and palette only; do not reproduce its sword or composition. Full bleed, no character, text, letters, numbers, frame, logo or watermark.

reference.role: Style and palette reference only, prior generated Whetstorm pilot. Rights and release clearance not independently verified.

generatedSource.description: Built-in generated PNG, byte-identical to master

processing: Pillow RGB Lanczos resize to 128x128, WebP quality 90 method 6; previews from candidate resized using Lanczos to 24 or 32 pixels, grayscale via Pillow grayscale and nearest-neighbor enlargement 10x.

gamePilotContext.note: Separate experimental game checkout; not a delivery in the art repository.

status: Experimental pilot candidate. Independent static 24px grayscale review found the filled ground field and dark-centered spiked ring distinct; precise mechanics are contextual. Gameplay review, rights assessment and release clearance remain pending; hashes do not establish rights.
